struct Vector {
  long long values[30];
};

struct Matrix {

};

int computeVal(long long num) {
  if (num < base) return num;
  return (num + computeVal(num / base)) % base;
}

Matrix matrices[30], inverse_matrices[30];
Matrix E[200][40], EI[200][40];
Vector current;

      for (int l = 0; l < base; l++) {
        result.matrix[i][j] += (m1.matrix[i][l] * m2.matrix[l][j]) % MOD;
      }
      result.matrix[i][j] %= MOD;
    }
  }
  return result;
}

Vector multiply(Matrix m, Vector v) {
  Vector v2;
  for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
    v2.values[i] = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
      v2.values[i] += (v.values[j] * m.matrix[i][j]) % MOD;
    }
    v2.values[i] %= MOD;
  }
  return v2;
}

void precompute() {
  for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
    E[0][i] = matrices[i];
    EI[0][i] = inverse_matrices[i];
  }
  int LOG = 0;
  long long t = total;
  while (t > 0) {
    LOG++;
    t /= base;
  }
  for (int j = 1; j <= LOG; j++) {
    E[j][0] = E[j - 1][0];
    EI[j][0] = EI[j - 1][0];
    for (int l = 1; l < base; l++) {

  }

    v = multiply(E[at][(w + i) % base], v);
